description: This file defines the class 'Smarty_Internal_Runtime_UpdateScope', which provides methods for updating variable scopes within Smarty templates, including scope propagation, affected scope retrieval, and variable updating across different template instances.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_UpdateScope
classes.description: Handles updating of variable scope in Smarty template rendering, supporting scope propagation and synchronization between template instances.

methods.name: _updateScope
methods.description: Updates a variable's scope across relevant templates, supporting global and local scope adjustments.

methods.name: _getAffectedScopes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of templates affected by scope changes based on the current template and scope mask.

methods.name: _updateVariableInOtherScope
methods.description: Copies or updates a variable in another template scope, ensuring consistency.

methods.name: _updateVarStack
methods.description: Updates variables in the local variable stack within a template.
